title: Breakdown of Foreign Domestic Worker Numbers by Nationality
what_it_is: Breakdown of Foreign Domestic Worker Numbers by Nationality

sections.label: Sensitivity of disclosing migrant data
sections.summary: Disclosing detailed data may create sensitivities among groups here and in countries of origin, though Australia publishes quarterly work visa data by origin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Disclosing such detailed data may create sensitivities among certain groups of people here and also in the countries of origin.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In countries, such as Australia, they publish data on a quarterly basis on the numbers of work visa holders, broken down by countries of origin and, with respect, I do not see how sensitive this can be.

sections.label: Reasons for not disclosing data
sections.summary: The data is not disclosed because of sensitivity, done for national interest and to protect Singaporean households, with Australia and Singapore being different.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: I would not want to delve into the details.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: But suffice to say that Australia and Singapore are quite different in terms of population size and also in terms of the domestic workers and the foreign workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Coming back to addressing the Member's question, why we do not disclose this piece of data is because of the sensitivity involved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Because of the sensitivity, I would rather not go into the details of why the data cannot be disclosed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: But I hope the Member would understand that this is done for the national interest and also for the interest of protecting the Singaporean households.
